      • displayChanged

        public void displayChanged()
        From the DisplayChangedListener interface. This method handles a display change - either when the display settings are changed, or when the window has been dragged onto a different display. Called after a change in the display mode. This event triggers replacing the surfaceData object (since that object reflects the current display depth information, which has just changed).
        指定者:
        displayChanged 在接口中 DisplayChangedListener

      • setBounds

        public void setBounds(int x,
                      int y,
                      int width,
                      int height,
                      int op)
        从接口复制的说明: ComponentPeer
        Sets the location or size or both of the component. The location is specified relative to the component's parent. The op parameter specifies which properties change. If it is ComponentPeer.SET_LOCATION, then only the location changes (and the size parameters can be ignored). If op is ComponentPeer.SET_SIZE, then only the size changes (and the location can be ignored). If op is ComponentPeer.SET_BOUNDS, then both change. There is a special value ComponentPeer.SET_CLIENT_SIZE, which is used only for window-like components to set the size of the client (i.e. the 'inner' size, without the insets of the window borders).
        指定者:
        setBounds 在接口中 ComponentPeer
        覆盖:
        setBounds 在类中 WComponentPeer
        参数:
        x - the X location of the component
        y - the Y location of the component
        width - the width of the component
        height - the height of the component
        op - the operation flag
        另请参阅:
        ComponentPeer.SET_BOUNDS, ComponentPeer.SET_LOCATION, ComponentPeer.SET_SIZE, ComponentPeer.SET_CLIENT_SIZE
